label: Gross salary, annual
note: Household gross pay before tax; the giving and savings shares are of this.

label: Pay frequency
note: Paychecks per year, for example 12, 24, 26 or 52.

label: Giving floor
note: The least share of gross to give.

label: Giving target
note: The share of gross to work toward.

label: Savings target
note: Share of gross planned into the savings groups named in the rules.

label: Housing cap
note: Housing categories (from the rules) over net paychecks.

label: Investing per paycheck
note: Deposited outside the budget app; not in the exports.
